card.name: Linking words before a new method or material
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "a", "an" or hyphen joins, right before a technical noun phrase. This happens in scientific citations and materials descriptions, and in prostate-drug labels before "GnRH/LHRH" terms.

modes.label: Measurement and materials titles
modes.description: "of" or a hyphen join inside engineering paper titles and materials descriptions.
modes.example: "Free-space Measurement of Complex Permeability<< of>> Magnetic Materials at Microwave Frequencies," IEEE

modes.label: Combination with a hormone agonist
modes.description: "a", "an" or "receive" just before gonadotropin-releasing hormone or LHRH in prostate cancer drug labels.
modes.example: Patients receiving abiraterone acetate tablets should also receive<< a>> gonadotropin-releasing hormone

modes.label: New class of catalysts
modes.description: "of" after "new class" in news about new materials.
modes.example: The new class<< of>> silver-based catalysts can produce the

card.writes: It seems to push down the word "novel" and similar words for a new approach, so the next word is a plain technical noun.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a specific technical term, such as a material, method or hormone drug.
